name_note: Genomes GTDB places in g__Faecalibacillus were deposited in NCBI mostly as Faecalibacillus but also as Coprobacillus and Clostridium, names used for the same organisms before the genus was proposed.

sentences.text: Faecalibacillus is a genus of long-rod-shaped, Gram-stain-positive, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming bacteria described within the family Erysipelotrichaceae.
Faecalibacillus intestinalis and Faecalibacillus faecis were proposed for strains isolated from faecal samples of healthy Korean subjects.
A study of patients with seven cancer types reported that Faecalibacillus intestinalis was under-represented in every patient group compared with sex- and age-matched healthy controls.
A twin-registry study reported that the abundance of Faecalibacillus intestinalis was positively associated with impaired fasting glucose.
A study of traumatic brain injury patients reported Faecalibacillus intestinalis among short-chain fatty acid-producing taxa depleted relative to healthy controls.
